people.name: Ananda Kentish Muthu Coomaraswamy
people.field: metaphysician, historian and a philosopher of Indian art

relations.subject: Ananda Kentish Muthu Coomaraswamy
relations.evidence: In 1900, he graduated from University College London (UCL), with a degree in geology and botany.

relations.subject: Ananda Kentish Muthu Coomaraswamy
relations.evidence: prompted the formation of the Geological Survey of Ceylon which he initially directed.

relations.subject: Ananda Kentish Muthu Coomaraswamy
relations.evidence: Coomaraswamy was invited to serve as the first Keeper of Indian art in the Boston Museum of Fine Arts in 1917.

relations.subject: Ananda Kentish Muthu Coomaraswamy
relations.role: Fellow for Research in Indian, Persian, and Mohammedan Art
relations.evidence: In 1933, Coomaraswamy's title there changed from curator to Fellow for Research in Indian, Persian, and Mohammedan Art.

relations.subject: Ananda Kentish Muthu Coomaraswamy
relations.evidence: Deeply influenced by René Guénon, he became one of the founders of the Traditionalist School.
